I made a welcome post a little while back, but I wanted to say something again since there are a few subscribers now.

First of all let me say hello! I'm glad all of you are here. The sub's name is pretty self explanitory, but it never hurts to explain something more than one. So, let's get down to it. /v/iwrotethis is a subverse for posting and sharing original pieces you have written. Pretty simple, right? I thought so too. We really aren't very picky about what kind of written work you submit here. There are just a few guidelines in the sidebar everyone should read before they throw up their submission. They are pretty simple, and just meant to keep every thing clean and flowing smoothly. While I expect, and in a perfect world this would happen every time, everyone to read the sidebar I am going to go over some of it here.

 

What can I post here?

Did you write it yourself? Is it an original poem, song, haiku, short story, or even a novel? If you wrote it you can share it here. Pretty straight forward, huh? That's really the only rule for what kind of material you can share here. It has to be your original work.

 

What can't I post here?

Did somebody else write it? Then don't share it. If you think it should be submitted here ask them to come and share it themselves. With this I am going to include fanfiction. For a couple reasons. Originally I talked to @GuereInoffensif about this, and I said I would let it slide for a little bit. However, after some time to think and look around I've decided we should send fanfiction pieces over to /v/Fanfiction. That is what it's for after all.

 

Now lets talk about submitting your pieces.

You need to tag your submissions. What does this mean? It's pretty simple. Since you can't flair posts right now you'll have to do it a little differently. Look at the very bottom of the sidebar, and you can see the list of flair we are currently using. Find the one that best fits your piece, and add it to the title in brackets. So you're submission title for a poem would look like this:

[Poetry] My sexy poem title goes here.

This makes it a lot easier to keep things organized here. The mods can see what your submission should be flaired as quickly and easily, and readers know exactly what they are jumping into before they click.

Now, this being said, the NSFW tag is expected if there is content in your piece that is not safe for work. Have you got a sex scene or two burried in a story? Tag it NSFW. For now we are going to trust everyone not to turn this into a sex stories sub. But, if things start turning pornographic here we will have to put an end to NSFW content. The sexual scenes shouldn't be there for nothing but arousal. As long as they are a part of a broader piece things will be golden. But, here is what your NSFW submission title should look like:

[Short Story][NSFW] I've got a dirty mind, and I write about sex. Read it.

It's a really simple system, but it will help keep things organized and clean for readers, and the mods.

 

Now that all that is out of the way...

I want to say I have really enjoyed what everyone has posted so far. And I can't tell you all how happy it makes me to see new submissions, and the subscriber list growing. I can't wait to read more from all of you. Yeah, even you @Dejers the Commenting Maniac.

I do have question for you subscribers who haven't shared something yet. Why not? I promise we won't bite. And, you may be surprised at the reactions you get here.

I hope to see you all sharing new submissions and comments soon!
